company.name: Morph
company.description: Inference optimized for coding agents. Run fast open-source models, search with WarpGrep, apply edits with Fast Apply, and compact context.

productsAndServices.description: A specialized AI model that applies code changes suggested by frontier AI models to existing code files at over 2000 tokens per second.
productsAndServices.name: Morph Apply

productsAndServices.description: A code embedding model trained on millions of commits to enable high-precision code search and retrieval.
productsAndServices.name: Morph Embeddings

productsAndServices.description: A reranking model trained on millions of code examples to prioritize the most relevant code snippets for prompt construction.
productsAndServices.name: Morph Reranking

productsAndServices.description: Inference optimizations and speculative decoding techniques to accelerate code edit application.
productsAndServices.name: Morph Speculative Edits

productsAndServices.description: An option to deploy Morph models and services within a company’s own cloud or infrastructure for security and control.
productsAndServices.name: Morph Self-Hosting Deployment

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,424,003 to $12,001,726, a 1.62x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-30).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
